summary: Game crashes when player model is rendered after the player is stung by a bee
description: The bug When getting stung by a bee, the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered. To reproduce There are multiple ways to reproduce this issue: Inventory - Get stung by a bee - Open your inventory Third-person camera - Enable third-person camera - Get stung by a bee Crash report 19w39a : [^crash-2019-09-27_13.19.08-client.txt] Description: Rendering entity in world java.lang.IllegalStateException: Not filled all elements of the vertex at cxk.a(SourceFile:253) at dwx.a(SourceFile:56) at dyd.a(SourceFile:48) at dyd.a(SourceFile:14) at duw.a(SourceFile:138) at dym.a(SourceFile:64) at dym.a(SourceFile:41) at dtz.a(SourceFile:268) at dtz.a(SourceFile:253) at dgt.a(SourceFile:134) at dgt.a(SourceFile:106) at dfx.render(SourceFile:82) at dgm.render(SourceFile:42) at dgt.render(SourceFile:86) at dpo.a(SourceFile:603) at dat.d(SourceFile:931) at dat.b(SourceFile:569) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:199)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Use the `/summon bee ~ ~ ~` command to spawn a bee near your player.
3. Approach and get stung by the bee.
4. Open your inventory immediately after getting stung.
5. Observe that the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered.

1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Press F5 to enable third-person camera mode.
3. Use the `/summon bee ~ ~ ~` command to spawn a bee near your player.
4. Approach and get stung by the bee.
5. Observe that the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered.
Observed Behavior: When a player gets stung by a bee, the game crashes immediately upon rendering the player model. This issue can be reproduced through several methods. One way to trigger it is by getting stung by a bee and then opening the inventory. Another method involves enabling third-person camera mode before getting stung by a bee. The crash report from version 19w39a provides additional details, indicating that the error occurs during the rendering process of entities in the world. Specifically, the exception `java.lang.IllegalStateException: Not filled all elements of the vertex` is thrown at various source file locations related to rendering functions and entity management. This crash consistently happens whenever the player model needs to be rendered after being stung by a bee, making it a critical issue that affects gameplay stability.
Expected Behavior: When the player gets stung by a bee, the game should not crash under any circumstances, such as opening the inventory or switching to third-person camera mode. The player model should render normally without causing any instability or crashes.
